en-US.涡轮分段（默认 2 段，最大 5 段）：段数越多越吃 CPU / 显存带宽；1: Turbo segmentation (2 segments by default, up to 5): more segments use more CPU / VRAM bandwidth; 1 segment means no segmentation.
